description: Poco’s X8 Pro’s rising price tag made it from an instant recommendation to a product that’s pretty much irrelevant in India’s premium smartphone segment. The device packs gaming-grade hardware and a minimalist and durable design along with decent battery backup, but comes up short of expectations because of its sibling, the Redmi Turbo 5.
title: Poco X8 Pro Review: A Good Mid-Range Gaming Phone

description: X offers the X Premium and X Premium+ subscription plans to users in India. The X Premium plan offers a verified checkmark next to your username. Moreover, it reduces the number of ads you see in your For You and Following timelines by half. On the other hand, the X Premium+ tier offers everything that the standard plan offers, along with some additional benefits. For reference, it provides a completely ad-free experience, the “largest” reply boost, and access to Radar with information regarding trends.
title: X Premium vs Free: Is X Premium Worth Buying in India in 2026?

description: With hybrid and remote work becoming common in the last few years, OEMs have come up with a lot of different offerings for those who work from home. Buyers can choose from traditional desktops, laptops, and increasingly, mini PCs for their home-office setup. The two most common approaches are usually a mini PC or a laptop. While the former packs much of the functionality of a full-fledged desktop in a box small enough to disappear behind a monitor, the latter is a single portable package that can be moved around from the dinner table to your bed.
title: Mini PC vs Laptop: Which Is Better for Home Office in India?

description: Looking for a budget-friendly soundbar? We've rounded up some of the best soundbars under Rs. 10,000 in India from Boat, JBL, Samsung, Portronics and Zebronics. These models offer features such as Dolby Audio, dedicated or built-in subwoofers, Bluetooth connectivity, HDMI ARC support and multiple audio modes. Whether you want better dialogue clarity, deeper bass or an affordable home theatre setup, these soundbars deliver a noticeable upgrade over your TV's built-in speakers.
title: Best Soundbars Under Rs 10,000 in India: Top Picks From Boat, JBL, Samsung and More

description: iQOO Z11 Lite 5G launched in India with a 6nm MediaTek Dimensity 6300 SoC paired with up to 6GB of LPDDR4X RAM and up to 256GB of UFS 2.2 onboard storage. It carries a 6,500mAh battery with support for 44W wired fast charging and reverse charging. Here's a detailed comparison of the iQOO Z11 Lite 5G, Moto G37 Power, and Oppo K14x 5G based on their price in India and specifications.
title: iQOO Z11 Lite 5G vs Moto G37 Power vs Oppo K14x 5G: Price in India, Specifications Compared

description: eSIM is a digital SIM that is embedded into compatible smartphones. It allows users to access services without inserting a physical SIM card. Airtel offers eSIM support for select smartphones from Apple, Google, Samsung, Motorola and Vivo. Airtel's eSIM works either alongside or instead of a physical SIM card. Here is a step-by-step guide on how to activate an Airtel eSIM on your smartphone.
title: How to Activate Your Airtel eSIM in 2026: A Step-by-Step Guide
